definition: Estates with a freehold are those that last for eternity. There are some freehold estate types where the estate lasts past the life of the owner and passes to their living heirs upon death in accordance with the terms of the will or the law. Other freehold estates exist only for the term of a person's life. freedom of the press / freehold estate Dictionary compilation | 26 September 2026 Contrast with nonfreehold estate.
